# transliteration scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](gmeow-transliterationScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transliterationScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The named transliteration/romanization system that produced an appellation's [`gmeow:romanization`](gmeow-romanization.md) (Hepburn vs Kunrei for Japanese; Pinyin vs Wade-Giles for Mandarin). Records HOW the romanization was derived. Non-functional. Domain [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) retrofits the names module; the scheme individuals are catalogued as FnO functions in the projection layer.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) -> [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](gmeow-transliterationScheme.md) from [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) to [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md), [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record which transliteration/romanization system produced an appellation's [`gmeow:romanization`](gmeow-romanization.md), so competing systems (Hepburn vs Kunrei, Pinyin vs Wade-Giles) are distinguished rather than silently merged.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to carry the romanized string itself (that is [`gmeow:romanization`](gmeow-romanization.md)) and avoid forcing one scheme — the same name may carry romanizations from several systems, so it stays non-functional.

### How to use

- On a [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md), pair [`gmeow:romanization`](gmeow-romanization.md) with [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](gmeow-transliterationScheme.md) naming the [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md) individual; the projection layer resolves the named scheme to its FnO transform when reconstructing or validating the romanization.

### Examples

- ex:tokyoName [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](gmeow-transliterationScheme.md) ex:schemeHepburn.
